description:
Search real, sourced apps that people shipped with AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Lovable, Bolt, Replit, v0, Windsurf, Rork, Base44).

Use when: the user wants real examples of apps built with a given AI tool, in a category, or matching keywords. Use get_app for one known slug; use latest_apps for the newest without a filter.

Behavior: Read-only. Keyword match (all words must appear) over title, one-liner, category, builder, tools and stack. Each result has title, one_liner, tools, category, stated revenue (as published, not audited), source_url and a Vibe Shipped link to cite. Returns total and up to limit results.

Example: {"tool":"lovable","q":"saas","limit":5}

category.description: Category id as listed by the site, e.g. consumer, saas, dev-tools, mobile-app.

tool.description: Tool id: cursor, claude-code, lovable, bolt, replit, v0, windsurf, rork, base44, grok-bot, other.

name: search_apps
title: Search apps built with AI
